Implementation Plan

Implementation plan for `phase-b-pre-llm-shortcircuit`

Clarification interpretation
- No `Q<ID>` items were asked in clarify; `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` indicates the task is clear and planning can proceed.

Representative implementation pattern
- Reuse the existing robust issue-creation pattern in `.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml` (`gh_retry gh issue create` + number extraction) from the `Create Wave 1 issues only` step.

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml`
- `README.md` (document new env var/default and short-circuit behavior)
- `agents.md` (update env/default behavior docs if this repo’s copy contains the env catalog)

2. Functions/modules/steps to implement
- Add job env var: `ORCHESTRATE_SHORTCIRCUIT_MAX_CHARS: ${{ vars.ORCHESTRATE_SHORTCIRCUIT_MAX_CHARS || '1200' }}`.
- Insert a new step immediately after `Pre-assemble static context` to evaluate:
  - description character count vs `ORCHESTRATE_SHORTCIRCUIT_MAX_CHARS`
  - no multi-step marker match using regex: `step\s*\d|phase\s*\d|wave\s*\d|\bthen\b|\bafter\b|and\s+then|multi[- ]?step`
  - emit outputs/env: short-circuit flag + explicit reason fields.
- Add a short-circuit step to create one plain GitHub issue from the project description (title from first non-empty line with fallback; body from full description).
- Gate decomposer/orchestrator path steps with the short-circuit flag so they do not run on short-circuit:
  - `Retrieve memory context`
  - `Build Codex prompt`
  - `Run Codex (decomposer)`
  - `Extract and validate decomposition JSON`
  - `Ensure orchestrator labels exist`
  - `Create tracking issue`
  - `Create integration branch`
  - `Create Wave 1 issues only`
  - `Build and post initial state`
  - `Record decomposition candidate`
  - `Dispatch Wave 1`
- Keep always-on terminal steps active in both paths:
  - `Write run summary`
  - `Record orchestration run end`
  - `Notify via Telegram`
- Update summary/notification content to report short-circuit mode and reason (instead of decomposition metrics) when short-circuit is taken.

3. Data structures affected
- New workflow env var: `ORCHESTRATE_SHORTCIRCUIT_MAX_CHARS` (default `1200`).
- New step outputs/env keys (example): `short_circuit`, `short_circuit_reason`, `short_circuit_length`, `short_circuit_marker_found`, `plain_issue_number`, `plain_issue_url`.
- No schema/db contract changes.

4. API/interface changes
- Workflow behavior becomes bifurcated:
  - Short-circuit path: creates one plain issue only.
  - Existing path: full decomposer + orchestrator flow unchanged.
- No external API interface change beyond one new configurable repo variable.

5. Risks and edge cases
- Regex false positives/negatives (mitigate with case-insensitive match and explicit logging of match result).
- Non-numeric `ORCHESTRATE_SHORTCIRCUIT_MAX_CHARS` value (sanitize/fallback to `1200` and log warning).
- Empty/whitespace description first line (fallback title required).
- Ensure plain issue receives no `ai:orchestrator-managed` / `ai:orchestrator-validate-required`, no tracking metadata block, no integration branch/state comment.
- Ensure no `codex exec` invocation in short-circuit path.
- Ensure end-of-workflow steps handle missing decomposition/tracking artifacts safely.

6. Testing considerations
- Path A (short-circuit): description length < threshold and no markers.
  - Expect exactly one plain issue created.
  - Confirm decomposer/orchestrator steps are skipped.
  - Confirm logs include explicit short-circuit reason.
  - Confirm no `codex exec` in logs.
- Path B (no short-circuit by marker): short description containing marker (e.g., “step 1”).
  - Expect normal decomposer path.
- Path C (no short-circuit by length): description > threshold without markers.
  - Expect normal decomposer path.
- For Path A, verify no tracking issue/integration branch/state comment/wave dispatch artifacts.
- Run workflow lint checks (`yamllint`, `actionlint`) after edits.

Conflict detection
- No factual repo-vs-issue conflicts found.  
- Sequencing note: existing `Retrieve memory context` currently sits between `Pre-assemble static context` and `Build Codex prompt`; the short-circuit evaluator can still be inserted in that interval and should gate `Retrieve memory context` + all decomposer steps to fully avoid decomposer-path cost.
